marketAudit.finding: TAGX was seeing much of the mover cohort, but persistence features were silently removed by a competing schema-v2 writer, while the remaining authoritative workflow showed excessive snapshot staleness. Fix lineage/freshness before altering ranking thresholds.

productionChanges.problem: Two scheduled workflows wrote tag/data/extended-hours.json with incompatible schemas.
productionChanges.change: Retired tagx-extended-hours-native.yml from scheduled production; kept manual-only for provenance.

productionChanges.problem: Authoritative writer remained on congested :00/:05 cron boundaries and current production snapshot was stale at 08:18 ET.
productionChanges.change: Moved authoritative cadence to :02/:07/... boundaries, tightened request timeout to 5s, increased workers to 24, retained 120-symbol cap and 3-minute job timeout.

expectedImpact: reduce snapshot age and improve deterministic cross-validation
reduce false positives caused by single-window velocity without quality context
championChallenger: No scoring threshold changed. Current ranking stays champion until restored schema-v3 evidence is observed across multiple movers/sessions.
